item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
Meera reads in her school diary that a solar eclipse will be visible from her town next month. Her younger brother Aarav asks her how a solar eclipse happens.

Which explanation should Meera give?

options.A: The Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth and blocks sunlight from reaching a small area of the Earth.
options.B: The Moon is always bigger than the Sun, so it can easily cover the whole Sun.
options.C: A solar eclipse happens whenever the Moon is on the day side of the Earth, even if its shadow does not fall on the Earth.
options.D: The Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, so the Earth's shadow falls on the Moon.
